name: Funke, Master of Thunder
desc:
Funke is a Canor NPC who acts as both progression for the Silentheart Oath and the Thundercall trainer.

In order to obtain Thundercall, you must bring 5 Spark Glands to Funke (2 if you have already obtained Thundercall on a previous character). Alternatively, if you have obtained the Silentheart Oath, you must kill them in order to get one of five Oath Talents.
additional_info:
-   Both they and [Nell](entity:nell_master_of_frost) wear the Black Diver outfit. According to Arch\_Mage, they are most likely Black Divers.
    -   If they are indeed Divers, this would make them and Nell the oldest, physically, known Divers, as they are the only Divers with wrinkles, excluding Coldheart Fortinbras.
-   Funke is the German word for "spark".
-   They did not wield the Stormseye, after its addition in the 6/5/2023 update, despite both being at Summer Isle and it being a Thundercall based weapon. This was finally corrected in the 11/10/2023 update, a staggering five months later.
    -   Arch\_Mage stated the reason was rifles not being coded for NPCs, but this was incorrect.
